PUID.description: Host user ID for file ownership.

PGID.description: Host group ID for file ownership.

setup-info.content: On first visit, you'll be asked to set up authentication. Create a username and password to secure your Sonarr instance.

root-folder-info.content: When adding your first show, set `/tv` as the Root Folder. This directory is persistently stored on your Mac.

download-client-info.content: Go to **Settings > Download Clients** to connect Sonarr to a download manager like NZBGet, SABnzbd, or qBittorrent. Configure it to save to `/downloads`.
